title: Discussing and suggesting
focus: 讨论、建议、意见、误会、指出、也就是说、估计、何必
body:
# Discussing and suggesting

Words for meetings and conversations: raising a point, suggesting, and clearing up misunderstandings.

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| 讨论 | tǎolùn | to discuss (a topic, as a group) | seek it out by talking |
| 建议 | jiànyì | suggestion / to suggest | put an idea up → suggest |
| 意见 | yìjiàn | objection / complaint (to have a problem with someone) | how you see it → complaint |
| 误会 | wùhuì | to misunderstand / a misunderstanding (between people) | grasp wrongly → misunderstand |
| 指出 | zhǐchū | to point out (a problem, a mistake) | point a finger out |
| 也就是说 | yě jiù shì shuō | which means / that is to say (drawing a conclusion) | which is also to say |
| 估计 | gūjì | I reckon / probably (an estimate) | estimate by reckoning → I reckon |
| 何必 | hébì | why bother / there's no need to | why must you → why bother |

## Which word?

**意见 vs 建议.** 建议 is a suggestion you offer. 对……有意见 means you have a problem with someone or something, a complaint.

## Sentences

- 他指出了问题的原因。 tā zhǐchū le wèntí de yuányīn: He pointed out the cause of the problem.
- 我建议先了解一下情况。 wǒ jiànyì xiān liǎojiě yíxià qíngkuàng: I suggest we find out what's going on first.
- 他对你没意见，是你误会了。 tā duì nǐ méi yìjiàn, shì nǐ wùhuì le: He's got nothing against you. You've misunderstood.
- 他指出的问题确实存在。 tā zhǐchū de wèntí quèshí cúnzài: The problems he pointed out really are there.
- 我建议明天讨论，估计今天解决不了。 wǒ jiànyì míngtiān tǎolùn, gūjì jīntiān jiějué bu liǎo: I suggest we discuss it tomorrow. I doubt we'll sort it out today.
- 他不同意，也就是说我们得重新讨论。 tā bù tóngyì, yě jiù shì shuō wǒmen děi chóngxīn tǎolùn: He doesn't agree, which means we'll have to discuss it again.
- 都是误会，何必生气呢？ dōu shì wùhuì, hébì shēngqì ne: It was all a misunderstanding. Why get angry?
- 大家对结果意见很大，估计要改。 dàjiā duì jiéguǒ yìjiàn hěn dà, gūjì yào gǎi: Everyone has a lot of complaints about the result, so it'll probably change.

cards.English: to discuss (a topic, as a group)
cards.Example: 这个问题我们明天开会再讨论。 zhège wèntí wǒmen míngtiān kāihuì zài tǎolùn: Let's discuss this at tomorrow's meeting
cards.Notes: 讨 tǎo seek, ask for, 讠 speech (讨价还价) + 论 lùn discuss, argue, 讠 speech (论文, 争论) = seek it out by talking, so discuss as a group. vs 商量 = talk over to decide something together.

cards.Example: 我建议你先问问医生。 wǒ jiànyì nǐ xiān wènwen yīshēng: I suggest you ask a doctor first
cards.Notes: 建 jiàn build, put up (建筑, 建立) + 议 yì discuss, 讠 speech (会议, 抗议) = put an idea up for discussion, offered rather than ordered. Verb and noun: 提建议 = make a suggestion. vs 推荐 = recommend a thing (a restaurant); 意见 often = complaint.

cards.English: objection / complaint (to have a problem with someone)
cards.Example: 大家对新规定意见很大。 dàjiā duì xīn guīdìng yìjiàn hěn dà: Everyone has big complaints about the new rule
cards.Notes: 意 yì idea, intention (意思, 同意) + 见 jiàn see (看见, 见面) = how you see an idea, so 'opinion'. But 对…有意见 means 'have a problem with', an objection or complaint. Shares 意 with 同意.

cards.Example: 你误会我的意思了。 nǐ wùhuì wǒ de yìsi le: You've misunderstood what I meant
cards.Notes: 误 wù mistake, 讠 speech (错误, 耽误) + 会 huì grasp, understand (体会, 领会) = grasp wrongly, so misunderstand. Spoken and about intentions; 误解 (解 untie, explain) is more formal, about ideas or facts.

cards.English: to point out (a problem, a mistake)
cards.Example: 他指出了报告里的几个问题。 tā zhǐchū le bàogào lǐ de jǐ ge wèntí: He pointed out a few problems in the report
cards.Notes: 指 zhǐ finger, point, 扌 hand (手指, 指甲) + 出 chū out (出去, 出来) = point out, literally. Used for problems and mistakes: 指出问题. Neutral, milder than 批评 (criticize).

cards.English: which means / that is to say (drawing a conclusion)
cards.Example: 合同下个月到期，也就是说我们得尽快决定。 hétong xià ge yuè dàoqī, yě jiù shì shuō wǒmen děi jǐnkuài juédìng: The contract expires next month, which means we need to decide soon
cards.Notes: 也 also + 就是 just is + 说 say = which is also to say. 也就是说 draws out an implication; 换句话说 rephrases.

cards.Example: 这么堵，估计我们要迟到了。 zhème dǔ, gūjì wǒmen yào chídào le: With traffic this bad, I reckon we'll be late
cards.Notes: 估 gū estimate (低估 underestimate) + 计 jì count, reckon, 讠 (计算, 设计) = estimate by reckoning. Very common spoken hedge; also a verb: 估计一下 estimate.

cards.English: why bother / there's no need to
cards.Example: 何必为这点小事生气呢？ hébì wèi zhè diǎn xiǎoshì shēngqì ne: Why get angry over something so small?
cards.Notes: 何 hé why, what (classical; 为何) + 必 bì must (必须) = why must you: why bother. Rhetorical; usually 何必……呢？ Shares 必 with 未必.

cards.English: He pointed out the cause of the problem.
cards.Pinyin: tā zhǐchū le wèntí de yuányīn.

cards.English: I suggest we find out what's going on first.
cards.Hanzi: 我建议先了解一下情况。
cards.Pinyin: wǒ jiànyì xiān liǎojiě yíxià qíngkuàng.

cards.English: He's got nothing against you. You've misunderstood.
cards.Hanzi: 他对你没意见，是你误会了。
cards.Pinyin: tā duì nǐ méi yìjiàn, shì nǐ wùhuì le.
cards.Notes: 意见 (L3) + 误会 (L3). 对…有意见 = have a problem with someone.

cards.English: The problems he pointed out really are there.
cards.Hanzi: 他指出的问题确实存在。
cards.Pinyin: tā zhǐchū de wèntí quèshí cúnzài.

cards.English: I suggest we discuss it tomorrow. I doubt we'll sort it out today.
cards.Hanzi: 我建议明天讨论，估计今天解决不了。
cards.Pinyin: wǒ jiànyì míngtiān tǎolùn, gūjì jīntiān jiějué bu liǎo.
cards.Notes: 建议 (L3) + 讨论 (L3) + 估计 (L3) + 解决 (L2). V不了 = can't manage to V.

cards.English: He doesn't agree, which means we'll have to discuss it again.
cards.Hanzi: 他不同意，也就是说我们得重新讨论。
cards.Pinyin: tā bù tóngyì, yě jiù shì shuō wǒmen děi chóngxīn tǎolùn.
cards.Notes: 也就是说 (L3) + 讨论 (L3) + 同意 (L1).

cards.English: It was all a misunderstanding. Why get angry?
cards.Pinyin: dōu shì wùhuì, hébì shēngqì ne?
cards.Notes: 误会 (L3) + 何必 (L3). 何必……呢 is rhetorical: no answer expected.

cards.English: Everyone has a lot of complaints about the result, so it'll probably change.
cards.Hanzi: 大家对结果意见很大，估计要改。
cards.Pinyin: dàjiā duì jiéguǒ yìjiàn hěn dà, gūjì yào gǎi.
cards.Notes: 意见 (L3) + 估计 (L3) + 结果 (L2).
